title: aspidium diffractum
intro: Aspidium diffractum, commonly known as the 'Rough Shield Fern', is a species of fern native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium diffractum include analgesic, antiarthritic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
